title: Implement a guarded bit caller for rank-seven dyadic ADDs
body:
## Summary

Close one local part of PR3078's fixed-width guard handoff. Add only `research/rank7-fixed-width-half-add/`, with proof, literal CX/CCX generator, two interpreters, exact source pins and replay evidence.

```text
W=64, k=3                    CNOTs   Toffolis   Total bits
reversible scratch baseline   1522      126         193
rotated source walk           1394      126         129
wired source caller            260      126         129
```

The signed caller implements `T += sign*S/2^k`, for k=1..3, and restores its writable source. Explicit bit connections avoid the rotations. The complete local guard bill is included: from two P-bit inputs, allocate 2k+1 zero bits, return k+1, and retain k fractional target bits as output. No destructive clear, rounding or free shift is used.

This is a **local direct-gate implementation result, not a runtime speedup, new κ or supplier admission**. Routing, clean-stock production, exclusive source ownership in the actual supplier, and the consumer's retained precision remain open. Neither implemented baseline is claimed optimal or an existing upstream bit compiler. The static inventory's 2,544 candidate literal gates are not automatically eligible native calls.

[Proof, source pins, reproduction and open questions](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/d764f9c11c86c40d35fd67811e60284feb1b8f10/research/rank7-fixed-width-half-add). [Discussion context and predecessor handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18983767). Base is canonical main `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6; unchanged at the submission checkpoint.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3078 materializes exact real-arithmetic recipes but leaves guard allocation and physical shifts unrun.
  **After:** 180 emitted bit circuits and 107,526 signed cases pass both a packed-bit and a separately written bit-array interpreter. All valid small input pairs at widths 4..7 are exhausted; signed boundary fixtures extend through 256 bits. A uniform written proof derives the exact gate/storage formulas.
- Thirteen behavioral groups cover negative sources, both signs, guard allocation, live target output bits, source restoration, omitted sign fill/cleanup, dirty carry, unguarded sources, overflow and source/serialization failures. Normal, optimized and Python 3.13 receipts agree. Registered Python 3.12 replay, formatting, correctness lint, source compilation and all 18 committed-file byte comparisons pass locally. Hosted CI and independent human review are separate.

```sh
TMPDIR="$RUN/tmp" python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/rank7-fixed-width-half-add
```

`RUN` is an existing external session directory with a `tmp` subdirectory. The package needs no numerical dependencies, native compiler, Docker or Lean.

Credit Cuccaro, Draper, Kutin and Moulton for MAJ/UMA ripple addition; PR3078/3060/3056, dcharb78/PR3042, Jeremy Kothe/PR3015, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Cinna Davis, eumemic, icekylinx and the retained native/geometry/owner lineage. Frozen predecessor words and notices are byte-identical. No priority is claimed for generic bit slicing or copy elimination. Development used substantial automated assistance.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

Only a new research package and its opt-in replay are added. Shared code, frozen predecessors, priorities and the selected frontier are unchanged. Actual native producer/consumer admission is not inferred from the local circuit.
